mapper.insert: insert into TEST.product_table (product_name, product_img1, product_img2, product_description, product_price, category_id, member_id) values (#{productName}, #{productImg1}, #{productImg2}, #{productDescription}, #{productPrice}, #{categoryId}, (select member_id from member_table where member_email = #{memberEmail}))
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_img1 AS productImg1, p.product_img2 AS productImg2, p.product_description AS productDescription, p.product_price AS productPrice, p.product_date AS productDate, p.category_id AS categoryId, m.member_id AS memberId, m.member_email AS memberEmail, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName FROM product_table p, member_table m , category_table c WHERE p.member_id = m.member_id and p.category_id = c.category_id and p.product_name LIKE '%' || #{productName} || '%' ORDER BY p.product_id DESC
